At line 7, `file` is created using `new File(getOutputFileNameWithPath(outPath, newFileName))`. This means the value of `file` depends on the result of `getOutputFileNameWithPath(outPath, newFileName)`.

The function `getOutputFileNameWithPath` takes both `outPath` and `newFileName` as parameters. Since `newFileName` is passed as an argument to this function, the value of `file` (which is constructed based on the output of this function) does indeed depend on the value of `newFileName`.

At line 17, `fileOutputStream` is created using `new FileOutputStream(file)`, so the final `FileOutputStream` object returned depends on the value of `file`, which in turn depends on `newFileName`.
